facts.claim: N3 treats a truthy object ID that is not all zeros as an object lookup candidate; it is not a full object ID format validator. uke deduplicates those IDs for the batch, then restores original request order via a map. A missing/zero ID yields not-found. Duplicate IDs initially reuse the same object outcome.

facts.claim: P3 executes git cat-file --batch at the repository root on the selected host, or through the supplied reviewSnapshot.git wrapper. Options preserve raw output, collect a byte buffer, disable lazy fetch with GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1, pass the worker signal, use a 30000 ms timeout, and bound combined output by per-ID byte allowance plus UTF-8 ID length and 64 bytes of framing.

facts.claim: vke parses newline-delimited batch headers and exact byte-sized bodies. A missing header outcome becomes not-found; invalid/unsafe/negative sizes become unknown. Oversized content becomes too-large with limitBytes. The output-limit paths can retry the unconsumed ID suffix; P3 concatenates prior results and retry results in order. This is declared parser/retry behavior, not a Git subprocess test.

facts.claim: Only fallbackToDisk === true combined with an inner not-found result takes the disk fallback. Too-large and unknown object errors do not fall back. The path is selected host platformPath.join(repository.root, request.path); it is not the annotation workspaceRoot. fke uses reviewSnapshot.read when provided and otherwise calls the named host read adapter directly.

facts.claim: hke first stats the selected host path with bypassCache:true, rejects a known size above the allowance, then reads a stream up to allowance+1 bytes. gke cancels the reader after filling that requested bound and releases its lock in finally. Excess bytes become too-large; accepted bytes are decoded as UTF-8 and split into lines. Physical host implementation and file receipt are unobserved.

facts.claim: Disk exceptions map to not-found only for an Error with ENOENT or one of the selected missing-file message strings; otherwise they map to unknown. Any exception caught by uke returns unknown for every request, so earlier object outcomes may be replaced. These inner outcomes remain distinct from an outer worker transport error.

facts.claim: qAe supports early or in-flight cancellation and suppresses its normal worker response after the controller is aborted. P3 passes that signal to the Git process boundary, but the fke/hke disk path receives no signal here. The selected Yt caller supplies none, so closing a file section is not evidence of canceling its background read. Cleanup/response behavior remains conditional on the surrounding awaits completing.
